items.name: actions/checkout
items.summary: Official GitHub Action that checks out the repository into the workflow workspace.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-written git clone/auth steps in GitHub Actions workflows.
cautions: Set persist-credentials: false unless later steps must push.
Pin to a commit SHA; default fetch-depth is 1.
install: Reference it with uses: in a workflow and pin to a full commit SHA (with a version comment) rather than a moving tag.

items.name: actions/setup-node
items.summary: Official GitHub Action that installs a Node.js version and optionally caches npm, yarn or pnpm dependencies.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-written Node installation and package-cache scripts in GitHub Actions.
cautions: Read the version from .nvmrc or package.json engines to keep CI and local in sync.
install: Reference it with uses: in a workflow and pin to a full commit SHA (with a version comment) rather than a moving tag.

items.name: actions/cache
items.summary: Official GitHub Action that saves and restores dependency and build caches between workflow runs.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-rolled artifact upload/download tricks for caching build outputs in GitHub Actions.
cautions: Never cache secrets or credentials; caches are readable by other branches' workflows.
Key caches on lockfile hashes.
install: Reference it with uses: in a workflow and pin to a full commit SHA (with a version comment) rather than a moving tag.

items.name: act
items.summary: Runs GitHub Actions workflows locally in Docker containers.
items.useWhen: Use instead of push-and-wait debugging of GitHub Actions workflows.
cautions: Runner images differ from GitHub-hosted runners; confirm on real CI.
Do not pass production secrets to local runs.
install: Install with the project's package manager or official installer, commit the lockfile and pin the reviewed version.
